units.sPeakWS/cPeakWS: lifetime peak process working set MiB
units.miss: missed scheduled start periods in window
units.sCPU/cCPU,sUser/sKernel,cUser/cKernel: process CPU microseconds per verified read

single_ack_encode.decision: Rejected after matched capacity windows. Protected separate server cycles split and unprotected blockwise p99 increased.

empty_inbound_owner_tables.decision: Rejected. Removed empty-table reads, but the expected incremental CPU saving at 32 slots did not repeat.

windows_process_io_control.scope: Two process I/O snapshots per role, outside the request loop. Windows counters aggregate all handles.

full_inbound_control.role_separation: Three release binaries with instrumentation off. Separate calibrated processes observed Exchange, Observe and pending owners across normal packet progress. The timed ledgers verify wire shape and capacities.
